leadText: Berry, Berry Interesting (Japanese: ハルカデリシャスで、ゴンベＧＥＴかも！！ With , Catch !!) is the 117th episode of Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire, and the 391st episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on March 3, 2005, and in the United States on February 11, 2006.
plainText:
Berry, Berry Interesting (Japanese: ハルカデリシャスで、ゴンベＧＥＴかも！！ With , Catch !!) is the 117th episode of Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire, and the 391st episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on March 3, 2005, and in the United States on February 11, 2006.

 

==Blurb==
 
 The kids are now headed to Slateport City. But while eating berries, Ash bites into a Tamato Berry and burns his mouth!

They reach a Pokémon Center and Ash goes off to practice Ice Beam with Snorunt, while May goes off to make PokéBlock. In the garden, Team Rocket is trimming hedges to earn money, but they're stepped on by an unrepentant Munchlax. They notice the Berry Blenders and get an idea.

Brock and Max watch people make PokéBlock. May comes in with her killer top-secret recipe for PokéBlock: May's Purple Surprise! But it tastes terrible to Brock and Max. The Pokémon also hate it. But Munchlax wanders in and loves it!

Team Rocket shows up dressed as professional PokéBlock tasters who claim to know all the secrets. Meowth and Wobbuffet then steal the PokéBlock while everyone's distracted. Oddly enough, Jessie also likes May's PokéBlock. But then the kids notice all of the PokéBlocks are missing and they blame it on Munchlax. It goes out into the garden and eats all the berries, but May stands up for it to the other kids.

She tries to capture Munchlax but nothing works. James bites into a Tamato Berry and runs away in pain; the kids see him and realize he must be a fake. Backed into a corner, Team Rocket grabs Pikachu. Munchlax jumps into the Team Rocket balloon to eat all the PokéBlock. With Snorunt's help, the kids defeat the thieves.

May tries to catch Munchlax; she throws the ball but Munchlax eats it. But it works, and she now has a new friend! 

==Plot==
On their way to Slateport City, where the Hoenn Grand Festival will take place, and stop at and come across trees filled with a wide variety of . Ash takes a bite out of a Tamato Berry and quickly discovers it to be extremely spicy. They stop by a Pokémon Center, where Nurse Joy is initially startled by Ash's swollen lips. While Nurse Joy checks out all of their Pokémon, Ash goes outside to continue working with to improve its . Outside, is relaxing on the ground from their gardening job when a steps on all of them. In anger, they give chase. Suddenly, Jessie stops at a nearby window when she sees a Berry Blender inside. Together they come up with a new plan. Meanwhile Snorunt continues launching its Ice Beam, but with extremely low accuracy. Ash accidentally gets hit by one of the rogue Ice Beams, but his wounds from the Tamato Berry are at least healed.

Ash's friends decide to make their own Pokéblocks after Nurse Joy gives them permission to use the Berries in the garden. comes up with her own Berry recipe called "May's Purple Surprise" consisting of two Pecha Berries, one Oran Berry, one Bluk Berry, and a small bit of Tamato Berry. The result is something that everyone, Pokémon and human alike, agrees is disgusting. However, the Munchlax that bothered Team Rocket wanders into the Pokémon Center, and turns out to be the one exception and loves May's Pokéblocks. Team Rocket comes in disguised as professional Pokéblock tasters, scamming people by offering advice on creating the perfect Pokéblocks while and steal all the Pokéblocks and blenders. To everyone's surprise, Jessie likes May's Pokéblocks too. Soon everyone realizes that their Pokéblocks are gone, and blame Munchlax, claiming it ate them all. Team Rocket chimes in to make sure Munchlax takes all the blame for the theft.

As they argue, Munchlax wanders off. Outside it finds more Berries, but gets cornered by the theft victims. Despite the lack of evidence, they still believe Munchlax is the thief. May and the group, including Nurse Joy, defend Munchlax since no one actually saw the Pokémon eat the blocks. May decides to catch it, and says that as its Trainer, she will take responsibility for disciplining it. She calls on to battle it. Combusken tries to use and , but Munchlax ends up dodging the moves. After Munchlax takes a short nap, it's finally ready to battle. It dodges another attack after getting distracted by a nearby Berry. Back inside, Team Rocket continue making Pokéblocks to sell. James samples a Tamato Berry and runs outside screaming from the spice. He ends up running right next to where Ash and the others are. The bag he's carrying has a hole in it, and when Pokéblocks fall out, everyone realizes who the real thieves are.

Jessie sneaks up from behind and uses a net to capture as she, James and Meowth remove their disguises and perform the motto. They take off in their , but with one Fire Spin from Combusken, Pikachu is set free. It also causes a hole to rip in one of the bags, causing Pokéblock to drop out. Munchlax notices and jumps up high to grab the bag and eat the rest. Jessie attempts to get Munchlax out, causing her to drop another one of the bags of which Munchlax jumps right out of the balloon. May tries to catch him, but Munchlax's weight causes her to fall into the ground. Ash has Snorunt use Ice Beam, but its accuracy remains poor as it freezes a nearby tree. Team Rocket gloat about their clean getaway to the heroes as they still have a bag of Pokéblock left, but one of the frozen tips of the tree pops their balloon, causing the balloon to slide and the fire burner to hit another tip, which then explodes and sends Team Rocket blasting off.

The Pokéblock from the remaining stolen bag begins to fall through the sky, and Munchlax quickly runs around eating them all. May takes the opportunity to try to catch it, but Munchlax also swallows the . To everyone's surprise, the Poké Ball is activated inside 's mouth, and it is . With that, the group's journey to the Grand Festival in Slateport City continues.

==Trivia==
 
Before the context of was known, the Japanese title of this episode was incorrectly translated as "May Deliciously Captures Munchlax".
The English dub title is a pun on the phrase "very, very interesting".
mentions Natalie from The Lotad Lowdown, who gave him the recipe book in that episode.
In Whiscash and Ash, when Sullivan attempted to catch Nero with a Master Ball, it ate the ball whole and got away without being caught. However, in this episode, swallowed the Poké Ball May used and was caught from the inside-out, which contradicts the failed catch in Whiscash and Ash.
This is the first appearance of a Generation IV Pokémon in the main series, the Pokémon in question being a . However, one did appear previously in Destiny Deoxys.
Ash's Grovyle's reaction to 's Purple Surprise is a reference to the ending of the boxing anime .
This episode marks one of the rare occasions in which a member of refers to one of the main protagonists by name. Once again, James calls May by her name.
This is one of the few episodes where doesn't pop out after Team Rocket finishes their .

===Errors===
The blurb for this episode incorrectly formats Pokéblock as PokéBlock. 
Additionally, the episode uses incorrect plural "Pokéblock" instead of the usual "Pokéblocks".
When says that he is from Pallet Town, the back of Nurse Joy's dress is colored white like her apron instead of pink.
Simiarly, when Nurse Joy says she will take good care of Ash and ' Pokémon, the collar of her dress is colored white like the apron instead of pink. This also occurs when she mentions that has various Berries.
When May starts making "May's Purple Surprise", the shape on her bandanna is on the left side of her head.
When Max mentions that May rushed making her Pokéblocks, the pocket on Nurse Joy's apron is missing.
When mentions how many Pokéblocks are at the Pokémon Center, one of 's legs is colored black like his tail instead of blue.
After James runs out of the Pokémon Center, his and Jessie's bags turn purple.
In one scene, Munchlax's underbelly is colored cream instead of teal.
In the scene where James drops the bag with Pokéblocks from Team Rocket's balloon, his swollen lips are colored yellow instead of red.
When rips a hole in Jessie's bag, her glove is missing.
In the Hungama TV/Marvel HQ dub, James refers to Ash and his friends as "five twerps and their Pikachu".
